title: explosion-proof-glass
description: Adds an indestructible glass block to Minecraft 1.20.1. This transparent glass has maximum explosion resistance (cannot be destroyed by any explosion) while maintaining vanilla glass appearance. Perfect for protecting builds from creepers and explosions.
body:
Explosion Proof Glass Mod

Add an indestructible glass block to your world. This mod introduces Explosion Proof Glass — a transparent glass block with maximum explosion resistance (same as bedrock), making it perfect for protecting your builds from creeper explosions, ghast fireballs, and other destructive forces.

Features:

    🔒 Unbreakable by explosions — Has maximum explosion resistance, cannot be destroyed by any explosion
    🪟 Transparent glass appearance — Uses the same texture and model as vanilla glass
    ⛏️ Requires tool to mine — Needs a pickaxe to collect (drops as an item)
    📦 Creative mode accessible — Available in the "Building Blocks" tab in creative inventory
    🎨 Clean and simple — No complex mechanics, just adds one useful block

Perfect for:

    Protecting valuable builds from griefers and accidents
    Creating secure windows in bases
    Building against creeper-prone areas
    Any situation where you need glass visibility with maximum protection
